name: ShopMaker – Elementor WooCommerce Builder, Widgets & Templates
author: smartwpress

sections.description:
🎯 ShopMaker is a complete WooCommerce page builder for Elementor — packed with 50+ powerful widgets and professionally designed templates for product pages, cart, checkout, thank you, shop, wishlist, and more.

Unlike many other plugins, all widgets are available even in the free version. You can create fully custom WooCommerce pages using our widgets with Elementor’s drag-and-drop interface. Some advanced styling and layout options (e.g., typography, color settings, or gallery layout) are available in the PRO version.

🚀 No coding required. Just drag, drop, and build.

Whether you’re customizing product pages, optimizing checkout, or creating creative landing pages, ShopMaker gives you full design control inside Elementor — and a smoother experience for your customers.

Key Features

  • 50+ Elementor widgets for WooCommerce
  • Full control over every WooCommerce page
  • Custom templates for product, cart, checkout, thank you, account, and more
  • Built-in import system with ready-made templates
  • Seamless integration with Elementor Free and WooCommerce
  • All widgets available in free version (with PRO-only advanced widget options)
  • Developer-friendly and performance-optimized

Say goodbye to ordinary online store designs – Shop Maker transforms your WooCommerce pages with its Elementor-powered WooCommerce page builder. Now, you have complete control over your page layouts, all designed to your exact specifications, with the added bonus of Elementor’s user-friendly drag-and-drop editor.

Whether you want to beautifully showcase your product listings, create captivating product pages, or optimize the checkout process, our widgets make it easy. You can effortlessly customize your pages using the intuitive drag-and-drop interface, ensuring your online store matches your unique vision.

Elevate your WooCommerce store, captivate your audience, and boost your online sales effortlessly. Make your WooCommerce Elementor e-commerce website truly extraordinary!

sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate ShopMaker via WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Ensure Elementor and WooCommerce are installed and active.
  3. Build or import Elementor templates with ShopMaker widgets.
  4. Assign templates for WooCommerce pages under ShopMaker → WooCommerce Templates.
sections.faq:
🧩 What is ShopMaker?

ShopMaker is an Elementor-based WooCommerce page builder with drag-and-drop widgets and customizable templates for every WooCommerce page.

⚙️ Do I need special setup?

Just install Elementor and WooCommerce—ShopMaker works immediately. No additional setup required.

🎨 Are all widgets available for free?

Yes! Free users can use every widget. PRO unlocks advanced styling options and layouts, Quick View, Wishlist and some template overrides.

🏷️ Which WooCommerce pages can I customize?

You can design custom pages for Product, Shop/Archive, Cart, Checkout, Thank You, My Account, and Wishlist.

🚀 How do I get started?

Create a new Elementor template using our widgets—or import and edit a ready-made template. Then assign it via ShopMaker → WooCommerce Templates.
